dedupe_keys.name: district heating thermal state estimation evidence benchmark

description: This district-heating state-estimation repository publishes model and preprocessing code, 56 saved PyTorch checkpoints, three numerical-evidence NPZ files, configuration and integrity checks. Its authors separate measured plant or substation observations from calibrated-simulator outputs and simulator-assisted hidden pressure or flow states. Controlled anomaly cases are generated stresses, not observed field faults. The code is MIT-licensed, while the measured Sønderborg, Flensburg and XAI4HEAT inputs retain separate terms. The processed Sønderborg file is intentionally not redistributed; a full rerun requires a separately obtained 18,703-row artifact that passes the repository’s SHA-256 check. This review read the documentation and file tree but did not download weights, install dependencies or run the model. Its source examples concern Danish and German district-heating systems, while the method’s transfer to another network is untested here. A modeller could inspect the frozen numerical evidence or rerun the estimator after securing source inputs, while keeping field measurements separate from reconstructed states. Related catalogue records data-sonderborg-district-heating-plants, data-flensburg-district-heating-network and data-xai4heat-district-heating-scada-nis describe the upstream measured sources, not this model package. Coverage of other district-heating systems has not been demonstrated.
